attempts.text:
**The window starts on two persistent columns.** Columns 0 to 1, `rbbA` and `yhhJ`, are carried by 97 to 100% of chromosomes, persistent, and in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names them in 99.6 to 99.8% of calls, with no column of the stretch above 0.05 bits.

**The first fork is at `yhhI`**, column 2, the most hesitant column of the window at 1.15 bits, in a region of plasticity in 23% of calls. Columns 2 to 3 are the stretch most in regions of plasticity, 23%, and the model names 73 to 84% there. A second branch carries transposases and a toxin-antitoxin pair, [[toxin-antitoxin and transposase genes]].

**Then a spine from `nikR` to `acpT`**, columns 4 to 10, carried by 96 to 97% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 7 to 23% of calls. The model names 82 to 99% there, fewest at `nikR`, 82%, with 0.56 bits. The long spine from `yhhT` to `ggt`, columns 12 to 39, is named in 70 to 99% of calls, fewest at `livJ`, 70%, and most hesitant at `ggt`, 0.37 bits; it carries nickel import, [[nickel import and transport]], and the `liv` and `ugp` operons, [[branched-chain amino acid transport]].

**A variable stretch at columns 40 to 43** is named in 90 to 95% of calls, fewest at column 41, 90%, with 0.47 bits. The spine from `yhhY` to `glgP`, columns 44 to 56, carried by 93 to 97% of chromosomes, is named in 91 to 98% of calls, fewest at `glgP`, 91%, and carries the `gnt` and `glg` genes, [[gluconate and glycogen metabolism]].

**The window ends in fork and variable columns**, 57 to 79, in a region of plasticity in 2 to 23% of calls, named in 76 to 96%, fewest at column 65, 76%, most hesitant at column 57, 0.47 bits. A second branch of 3 families runs through columns 57 to 59, carried by 15 to 36% of chromosomes. The variable columns 63 to 78 carry `rtcA` to `envZ`, and the window ends at column 79, `pckA`, in 36% of chromosomes. Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside, 0.52 against 0.15 bits, and names fewer genes, 82% against 94%.

label: rbbA
facts:
WINDOW: the rbbA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor rbbA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 236 to 315 from dnaA. Read in 534 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying rbbA once); 42,720 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 93% of genes, 0.18 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 35,684 calls, named 96%, 0.10 bits; shell 6,864 calls, named 82%, 0.59 bits; cloud 172 calls, named 45%, 1.09 bits. Outside an RGP 39,275 calls, named 94%, 0.15 bits; inside an RGP 3,445 calls, named 82%, 0.52 bits. Columns: 50 spine, 8 fork, 22 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.52 against 0.15 bits) and names fewer genes (82% against 94%); 3,445 of the 42,720 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 2 (yhhI) 1.15 bits, RGP 23%; column 4 (nikR) 0.56 bits, RGP 23%; column 3 (yhhH) 0.54 bits, RGP 23%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 2-3 (fork), RGP 23%; the least: columns 0-1 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-1 (2 columns) spine: share 97-100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: rbbA, yhhJ. named 99.6-99.8% (mean 99.7%), fewest named at column 1 (yhhJ), named 99.6%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.05 bits (column 0 (rbbA)).
2. columns 2-3 (2 columns) fork: RGP 23%. named 73-84% (mean 78%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 2, named 73%, 1.15 bits.
   2: yhhI S 43% "ISAs1 family transposase"; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 22%, hicA S 21%, gatY S 16%
   3: yhhH S 46% "protein YhhH"; also hicB S 25%, "HPr family phosphocarrier protein" S 16%
3. columns 4-10 (7 columns) spine: share 96-97%, all P, RGP 7-23%. Genes: nikR, nikE "nickel import ATP-binding protein N…", nikD, nikC, nikB, nikA, acpT. named 82-99% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 4 (nikR), named 82%, 0.56 bits.
4. column 11 variable: RGP 4%. named 96%; 0.08 bits.
   11: rsmJ P 3%
5. columns 12-39 (28 columns) spine: share 94-97%, all P, RGP 1-11%. Genes: yhhT, yhhS "MFS transporter", dcrB, yhhQ "7-cyano-7-deazaguanine/7-aminomethy…", tusA, zntA, yhhN "lysoplasmalogenase", yhhM "DUF2500 domain-containing protein", yhhL "DUF1145 family protein", rsmD, ftsY, ftsE, ftsX "permease-like cell division protein…", rpoH, livJ, panM, livK, livH, livM, livG "high-affinity branched-chain amino…", livF, ugpB, ugpA "sn-glycerol-3-phosphate ABC transpo…", ugpE, ugpC, ugpQ, yhhA "DUF2756 domain-containing protein", ggt. named 70-99% (mean 94%), fewest named at column 26 (livJ), named 70%; most hesitant at column 39 (ggt), 0.37 bits.
6. columns 40-43 (4 columns) variable: RGP 3%. named 90-95% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 41, named 90%, 0.47 bits.
   40: yrhB S 73% "YrhB domain-containing protein"
   41: yrhD S 57%
   42: yrhA S 70% "protein YrhA"
   43: tssD S 67%
7. columns 44-56 (13 columns) spine: share 93-97%, all P, RGP 1-18%. Genes: yhhY "GNAT family N-acetyltransferase", yhhX "oxidoreductase", yhhW "pirin family protein", gntR, gntK, gntU "gluconate:H+ symporter", yhgN "MarC family protein", asd, glgB, glgX, glgC, glgA, glgP "glycogen/starch/alpha-glucan phosph…". named 91-98% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 56 (glgP), named 91%, 0.42 bits.
8. columns 57-79 (23 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 2-23%. named 76-96% (mean 91%), fewest named at column 65, named 76%; most hesitant at column 57, 0.47 bits.
   a second branch of 3 families through columns 57-59, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 15-36%, all S; the branch's families: "substrate-binding domain-containing pro…", "substrate-binding domain-containing pro…", "hypothetical protein"
   57 fork: glpD P 89%; also "hypothetical protein" S 27%, "fimbria/pilus outer membrane usher prot…" S 14%
   58 fork: glpE P 89%; also "hypothetical protein" S 28%
   59 fork: glpG P 89% "rhomboid family intramembrane serin…"; also "hypothetical protein" S 29%, "fimbrial biogenesis chaperone" S 10%
   60 fork: "DeoR/GlpR family transcriptional regula…" P 89%; also "fimbrial protein" S 13%
   61 variable: rtcR P 83%
   62 fork: rtcB P 84%; also "fimbria/pilus periplasmic chaperone" S 14%
   columns 63-78 variable, share 47-86%, 15 P, 1 S: rtcA "RNA 3'-terminal phosphate cyclase" 80%, malT 86%, malP "glycogen/starch/alpha-glucan phosph…" 85%, malQ 84%, gntT 82%, nfuA 81%, gntX 79%, bioH 78%, rpnA 75%, feoC 76%, feoB 72%, feoA "ferrous iron transporter A" 70%, yhgF "S1 RNA-binding domain-containing pr…" 66%, greB 62%, ompR 53%, envZ 47%
   79 fork: pckA P 36%; also yhgE P 19%
